issues: The three eggs have pointed tips, so they read as buds and not as eggs.
The nest shows smooth bands and a smooth rim, so it reads as a basket and not as twigs.
The side view shows one egg. The other two eggs hide behind it.
storytime-nest.fix: Round the three egg tips into smooth ovals and break the rim into rough twigs.

issues: The cap edge is ragged, and the cap shows no scale texture.
The nut reads as one big brown acorn in all four views.
The mesh shows as thin lines, and the background shows through it.
The mesh narrows to a point at the bottom, so the object reads as a racket.
The handle shows a seam and has no grip.
storytime-butterfly-net.fix: Hang a deep soft mesh bag under the hoop so it reads as a butterfly net.

issues: The back is one large plain panel.
No symbol appears on the front, the three-quarter, the side, or the back.
The cap has no band and no strap at the back.
The green cross on the cap is not a defect for this page. The no-symbol rule covers the bag only.

critical: The extended finger is missing. The hand is a closed lump beside the nose.
issues: The head turns nearly to profile for the hold, so the face and the laugh stay hidden.
The side row shows the back of the head for most of the clip.
The lump sits at the cheek and not at the nose tip.
gesture-touch-nose.fix: Turn the head to the camera and extend one finger to the nose tip.

issues: The chin lift reads well in the side view, but it stays mild in the front view.
The hands sit under the jaw on the sides of the neck, and not on the throat.
The side view shows one hand. The far hand hides behind the body.
